bio: Calder has devoted his life to the mysteries of the world. His mind is his greatest weapon, though his allies are his greatest strength.

abilities.name: Arcane Bolt
abilities.effect: A bolt of pure force. Unlimited uses.

abilities.name: Prestidigitation
abilities.effect: Minor effects at a distance: move light objects, light or snuff a flame, clean, mark. No damage.

abilities.name: Containment
abilities.effect: Holds a creature or shape in place for a few moments. It doesn't harm it. Objects and presences with no will of their own take on a definite form while contained.

abilities.name: Arcane Shield
abilities.effect: Reaction: +5 to armor against a blow that's already on its way.

abilities.name: Arcane Lore
abilities.effect: Can identify magic, creatures, and arcane phenomena with an Arcana check.

goal: Answer a question that has gone unanswered for twenty years.
